02 / Read

AI reads every signal in context.

Inbox, CRM, forms, and documents are interpreted against your data — what it is, who it belongs to, and how urgent it is — instead of waiting in a queue for someone to notice.

03 / Govern

Policy decides what happens next.

Business rules, confidence thresholds, and named owners route each item: resolved automatically, sent to the right team, or held for a person to review. Nothing important moves without a trail.

04 / Operate

Work becomes a governed flow.

Your teams see one live view of what was handled, what is moving, and what needs judgment — built on Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure, and Fabric you already trust.
